description: This is a PHP source file for the ApplicantController class within the OrangeHRM recruitment plugin. It handles applicant submissions, including validation and storage of candidate data, attachments, and application processing logic.

classes.name: ApplicantController
classes.description: Controller handling applicant submissions in the recruitment module, including validation, attachment processing, and candidate data persistence.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Main entry point for processing applicant submissions. Handles file upload, validation, transaction management, and redirection.

methods.name: validateParameters
methods.description: Validates request parameters and the uploaded resume attachment, ensuring data integrity and correctness.

methods.name: processTransaction
methods.description: Processes the applicant data and attachments, saving candidate, vacancy, history, and attachment records.

methods.name: setApplicant
methods.description: Populates a Candidate entity with data from the request.

methods.name: setApplicantVacancy
methods.description: Associates a candidate with a vacancy and sets the application status.

methods.name: getValidationDecorator
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the ValidationDecorator instance used for validation rules.

methods.name: getParamRuleCollection
methods.description: Defines validation rules for request parameters.

methods.name: setCandidateAttachment
methods.description: Assigns attachment data to a CandidateAttachment entity.
